title: PageDefinition (stored input)
description: Stored definition of a page. This is the INPUT to the engine's 4-stage pipeline — not the rendered output (see page-response.schema.json for that). Stored as JSONB in page_versions.definition. The cloud dashboard writes this; the app-server reads it to run the pipeline.

title.description: Page title used by the SDK for route/app-bar titles.

appState.description: App-level state keys this page needs access to. The SDK subscribes to these keys.

cachePolicy.description: Page-level cache policy. Overrides the flow-level policy if set.

state.description: Initial state declarations. The SDK seeds its ElmStore with these before rendering.

infoData.description: Data fetching configuration for Stage 1 of the pipeline. In the cloud, this replaces the engine's getInfoData() function with a declarative config.

url.description: API endpoint URL to fetch data from.

transform.description: JSONPath expression to extract data from the response.

forceUpdate.description: When true, the page always re-fetches data on revisit.

widgets.description: Widget tree definition. Each entry is a widget node (pre-flatten). The engine's render stage produces this; in the cloud's visual editor, it's built by drag-and-drop.

_dashboard.description: Dashboard-only metadata. NOT consumed by the engine or sent to the app. Used by the cloud dashboard UI to display route context for this page.

route.description: The full route path this page is served at (e.g. '/home', '/product/:id'). Derived from the flow's route tree.

children.description: Child routes nested under this page's route. Each item shows the child path and which page it maps to.

flowSlug.description: Slug of the flow that contains this page's route.

WidgetNode.description: Pre-flatten widget tree node. Mirrors the engine's Widget.new() output structure. The encoder flattens this into ComponentNode[] at render time.

key.description: Optional stable key for the widget.

props.description: Widget props. Values can be plain JSON or Value objects.
